original.statement: Helm value enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is deprecated and is a no-op in 1.16.

decision.reason: [ev-99f86df45975] says the Helm option `enableRuntimeDeviceDetection` is now deprecated and is a no-op, and it names no replacement key. Only environments that set this values key are affected, because a value they supply is now ignored. Environments that leave it unset supply nothing that could be ignored. So values-key{enableRuntimeDeviceDetection, set} is the exact exposure condition. The computed default diff (false → true, from the v1.15.6 and v1.17.0 values in [ev-28e0ccb5774a] and [ev-39a22d88e2f5]) does not widen this, because the setting no longer has any effect either way.
